title: Not what I needed.
text: Not what I needed.. I wanted this to spread cream cheese straight out of the refrigerator.  I washed the blade, charged it and then turned it on for 10 minutes for it to heat up.  It never heated to the 70 degrees Celsius and took longer to go through the cream cheese than if I had used a butter knife.  Since it did appear to have some warmth to it, I gave it even more time to heat up.  It did heat up warmer, the problem is that it doesn't maintain a constant temperature.  As soon as I cut through the cream cheese, the knife was cold again and I had to wait for it to warm up.  By the time I finished with the first 8 oz. bar of cream cheese, the second bar was soft enough to cut and spread it with a butter knife.  Unfortunately, I didn't use it soon enough to be able to send it back so I'm stuck with it.  Hopefully it will do better on butter.
